recommendedTextbook.title: New School Chemistry for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O.Y. Ababio
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education & NERDC

topics.topic: Introduction to Chemistry and the Scientific Method
subtopics: Definition of chemistry and its branches
objectives: Define chemistry and explain inorganic, organic, and physical branches
List sequential steps of the scientific method

topics.topic: Particulate Nature of Matter and Atomic Theory
subtopics: Dalton's atomic theory and modern modifications
Atomic number, mass number, and isotopes
objectives: Differentiate subatomic particles by mass and charge
Calculate relative atomic mass from isotopic abundances

subtopics: IUPAC chemical symbols of common elements
Valency and writing chemical formulae of binary compounds
objectives: Write correct chemical symbols for first 30 elements
Derive chemical formulae using cross-valency method
Balance chemical equations with state symbols

topics.topic: Chemical Bonding: Ionic and Covalent Bonds
subtopics: Octet rule and stability of noble gases
Covalent bonding: Single, double, and coordinate bonds
objectives: State octet and duplet stability rules
Illustrate ionic bond formation in NaCl and MgO
Compare physical properties of ionic and covalent compounds

topics.topic: Atomic Structure, Electronic Configuration and Periodic Classification
subtopics: Constituents of atoms: Protons, neutrons, electrons, and isotopic composition
Atomic numbers, mass numbers, and relative atomic mass determination
Electronic configuration using Bohr and modern s, p, d, f orbital models for the first 20 elements
objectives: Write s, p, d, f electronic configurations for elements with atomic numbers 1 to 20.
Explain periodic trends (ionization energy, electronegativity, atomic radius) across periods and groups.
Perform stoichiometric calculations of relative atomic mass from mass spectrometer isotope percentages.
